item.title: [7.0] A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools....

WHY IT MATTERS

The introduction of AgenticBBO-Bench standardizes evaluation for LLM agents in black-box optimization across diverse scientific and engineering domains, addressing a key fragmentation issue in the field.

item.title: [6.9] OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video,...

WHY IT MATTERS

OuroWorld successfully bridges static 3D Gaussian Splatting and dynamic 4D generation, enabling seamless looping cinemagraphs from arbitrary viewpoints.

item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Gold prices surged as investors seized the opportunity to buy low after a recent dip to a two-month low. Currently, spot gold has ascended to around $4,190.49 and is on track for a weekly increase. Traders are closely monitoring potential interest rate adjustments by the US Federal Reserve.

WHY IT MATTERS
